skill_name: Tell us the differences between a refrigerator and a freezer.
workflow: A refrigerator and a freezer differ in their primary function, temperature, and design. A refrigerator is typically used to store food and beverages at temperatures between 35 to 40 degrees Fahrenheit, while a freezer is designed to keep food at temperatures between 0 to -18 degrees Fahrenheit.
